title: Exit Portal Target Scene Unassigned Causing Transition Failure
explanation: At frame 3165 (t=53.16s), the player reached the level terminus and entered Portal2D at (17200, 640), but next_scene was null. Traced to Portal2D.gd:L35-L45 (teleport) where missing next_scene logs missing_expected_object and portal_target_missing, aborting transition and soft-locking progression.
repro_hint: Navigate to the exit portal in Map2; reaching the portal fails to trigger scene change due to unassigned target scene.
